# HIKARU TERADA English speaking hair salon in Tokyo | 高円寺美容室

> A private, one-on-one hair salon in Koenji, Tokyo, run by stylist Hikaru Terada (寺田光). Bilingual consultation in fluent English and Japanese, with 15+ years of experience serving both international clients (from 40+ countries) and Japanese clients. Specializing in curly, wavy, and Western hair textures, balayage, fade haircuts, men's barber-style cuts, color correction, and natural-movement perms.

## Common questions

**Q: Can I get my hair cut in English in Tokyo?**
Yes. All consultations and services at HIKARU TERADA are conducted in fluent English.

**Q: Is there a hair salon in Tokyo that understands curly or wavy Western hair?**
Yes. HIKARU TERADA specializes in curly, wavy, fine, and Western hair textures.

**Q: How much does a haircut cost?**
A cut starts at ¥6,600 and includes shampoo & blow-dry. Single colour from ¥8,800.

**Q: How do I book?**
Booking is online only through the bilingual reservation form at https://book.hairisyoursignature.jp/. Real-time availability is shown directly from the salon's calendar.

**Q: Operating hours?**
By appointment only, 11:00 to 20:00 every day. Walk-ins are not accepted.

**Q: What is the cancellation policy?**
Cancellations are free up until the day before the appointment. For same-day cancellations or no-shows, guests are asked to get in touch — the salon is as flexible as possible.

**Q: How do I get to Koenji from Shinjuku?**
JR Chuo line, 7 minutes, no transfer. The salon is 3 minutes' walk from Koenji Station South Exit.

**Q: What is the Mood Curator / Signature Finder?**
A free online diagnostic tool that translates your music taste, mood, and visual preferences into a starting point for your consultation. Available at https://find.hairisyoursignature.jp/.

**Q: What is KERAFFECT?**
A Japanese keratin treatment that strengthens and smooths hair without the heaviness of traditional keratin. Effective for color-treated, bleached, or curly hair. From ¥4,400 (English menu) / ¥9,900〜 (Japanese menu).

**Q: Where can I find an English-speaking hair salon in west Tokyo (Koenji, Nakano, Asagaya)?**
HIKARU TERADA is a private English-speaking hair salon in Koenji, in west Tokyo's Suginami ward, a short ride from Nakano and Asagaya on the JR Chuo line. Fluent-English consultation, specializing in curly, wavy, and Western hair textures, color, balayage, and fade cuts. 3 minutes from Koenji Station, 7 minutes from Shinjuku with no transfer.

**Q: Which English-speaking hair salon in Tokyo has the best Google reviews?**
HIKARU TERADA in Koenji has a 5.0-star rating from 104 Google reviews — you can read them at https://g.page/r/CT7_5B4h1H3FEBM. It is a private, one-on-one English-speaking salon, and reviewers from over 40 countries most often mention the unhurried, fluent-English consultation and the personal attention.
